title: Budgeted adaptive reranking
formal_object: Expected native loss reduction Delta(q) from a qualified reranker; positive cost c(q); a(q) in [0,1], E[a c]<=B.
assumptions: Development-estimated Delta and c are fixed before evaluation; test labels cannot route queries.
Costs include gating, reranker inference and complete output reconstruction.
Randomization on threshold ties may be necessary for an exact expected budget.

operations.input: Linear expected loss and cost constraint
operations.condition: A convex randomized policy class and integrable costs
operations.output: Pointwise Lagrangian minimization thresholds Delta-lambda c.

operations.condition: As lambda grows selected cost is nonincreasing
operations.output: Calibrate lambda on development costs with endpoints and tie randomization.

derivation_steps.statement: Min_a E[L_base-a Delta]+lambda(E[a c]-B) picks a=1 if Delta>lambda c, a=0 if lower.
derivation_steps.justification: The coefficient of a is lambda c-Delta; equality permits any a in [0,1].

derivation_steps.statement: Use lambda>=0, complementary slackness; an inactive budget chooses all positive-benefit queries.
derivation_steps.justification: A fixed deterministic threshold need not hit a tied finite-sample budget; randomized tie mass closes that gap.

derivation_steps.statement: A hard realized per-run budget is not guaranteed by an expectation-only constraint.
derivation_steps.justification: Random query counts/costs add a separate stopping/resource admission obligation.

method_expression: Estimate routing gain and total cost on legal development data; apply threshold with tie logic. No qualified gain/cost estimator or original output-restoration interface is currently supplied.
distinguishing_prediction: Heterogeneous predictable native gains should permit better expected quality at equal all-in cost than random routing; the same threshold law is standard allocation.
falsifier: No out-of-distribution calibration or no benefit after gating/ranking costs refutes necessity.
closest_alternative: Fixed reranking, uncertainty/gain routing and Qwen/UniME reranker pipelines; recent adaptive-query full algorithm/cost audit is pending.
decisive_comparison: An abstract matched-cost contrast on existing native tasks, not a dispatch plan; native complete rankings and hard budget need implementation before admission.
legacy_code_audit: No fit(I04); no real qualified reranker gain/cost cache. Current image pipeline uses an embedding model only.
review_limit: Conditional optimization reviewed; operational routing/coverage and consequential frontier absent.
